intent: Add the non-authorizing vertical slice from exact proposal evidence to signed terminal refusal. RuntimeState gains atomic collision-safe exact proposal receipts and reserved exact child identities; Mission Control accepts a candidate only from the exact proposal receipt/idempotency pair. The candidate boundary snapshots request, source, diff, and Candidate bytes into an external content-addressed bundle, and downstream processes consume those verified in-memory bytes rather than reopening candidate-controlled paths. Release admission runs under env -i before any provider or signing credential is restored, then admitted Foundry and Vibe processes receive mutually exclusive key paths. Distinct OS processes record insert-once durable child identities and signed non-authorizing process receipts. Foundry always remains foundry_inconclusive; Vibe is candidate-bound ran=false and unchecked; the result bundle records caller_asserted_no_effect with repository authorization and performed flags false. The parity artifacts reseal the unchanged relevant-source semantics at 60/100. This packet proves a fail-closed refusal reflex, not a promotion warrant, canonical producer, live effect, terminal Mission Control transition, or production deployment.

honest_blockers: The RuntimeState database and verifier trust roots are caller-selected in this slice. Canonical-store custody, durable semantic-executor parent observation, and candidate-authority binding remain unproven.

Two distinct verifier OS processes, PIDs, boot IDs, public keys, and key inodes are observed. Same-user hostile-process independence, supervised provenance, and exclusive private-key custody remain unproven.
Foundry has no real trial ledger or attested Docker CLI, daemon, image, runtime, cleanup, or ignored-release-path chain, so it emits only foundry_inconclusive.
Vibe deliberately does not run: its signed candidate-bound receipt is ran=false and unchecked. No independently admissible Vibe verdict or production trust root exists.
No composition-owned semantic producer emits the exact proposal and candidate bundle, and Mission Control deliberately refuses these process receipts as promotion warrants.
No sealed effect capability, repository mutation, external-owner terminal receipt, or TaskBoard terminal transition exists in this slice.
Two clean-restart positive runs with a real provider, exactly one authorized effect, and exactly one terminal receipt per run have not been demonstrated.
PR 1466 requires approval before merge; passing packet, local, or CI verification does not satisfy that external human gate.
interface_mismatches: The refusal-only v1 bindings alias A2A packet and delivery identifiers as attempt_id and lease_id. They are not canonical Mission Control delegation_runs.run_id and task_claims.claim_id values and cannot satisfy a future positive authority lane.

The current read-only projection expects a pending task, while a real Mission Control attempt projects it to assigned or running. A positive lane must bind the running task to the exact mission attempt and claim.

Foundry evaluation, Vibe observation, signed evidence, RuntimeState attestation, repository-effect authority, terminal receipt, and TaskBoard projection are distinct authority modalities; no earlier layer may be promoted into a later one.
A signed process receipt proves key possession for one payload, not exclusive private-key custody or hostile-process independence.
Runtime receipts record evidence but are not bearer capabilities; an effect evaluator must require a separately sealed nominal capability and exact candidate binding.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this integration commit, including exact proposal-stage support, candidate and no-effect bundles, admitted verifier commands, exact child-identity reservation, the parity reseal, and this packet. External evidence bundles, signed receipts, and RuntimeState rows are append-only evidence and are not deleted or reinterpreted by a Git rollback.
